label: first-custody-adjacency_forward
statement: SELECT _change_type,count(*),sha2(concat_ws('',sort_array(collect_list(sha2(concat(CASE WHEN source_system IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(source_system AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(source_system AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN rel_type_id IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(rel_type_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(rel_type_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN id IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(id AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(id AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN source_type IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(source_type AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(source_type AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN source_id IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(source_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(source_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN target_type IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(target_type AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(target_type AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN target_id IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(target_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(target_id AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END,CASE WHEN entity_version IS NULL THEN 'N;' ELSE concat('V',cast(length(encode(CAST(entity_version AS STRING),'UTF-8')) AS STRING),':',hex(encode(CAST(entity_version AS STRING),'UTF-8')),';') END),256)))),256) FROM table_changes('client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.mixed_adjacency_forward_r332',2,2) GROUP BY _change_type ORDER BY _change_type
